description.value: Injecting a target with Speedheal immediately causes them to heal HP equal to their BODY plus their WILL. This effect does not work on Mortally Wounded targets, and can only be used on a target once per day.
Injecting a target with Stim causes them to ignore all penalties from being Seriously Wounded for one hour. It can only be used on a target once per day.
